peer.method: Percentiles: 100 = best among the group's pool (players meeting its minimum); rates are shrunk towards the pool mean by a few pseudo-matches before placing. Similar players: weighted Euclidean distance on z-scores within the pool (weights = season-to-season reliability, floored at 0.2 and capped at 0.8), the 5 nearest; the tour view takes clay and grass Elo as the gap to overall Elo.
